caption: The drawing depicts two vertically oriented ribbon designs side by side, both set against a light background. Each ribbon is composed of a series of colored sections with symbols and text. The left ribbon features the word "RICHMOND" in blue followed by "1865" in red at the top, with an eagle clutching a striped shield below. Underneath the eagle is a green laurel wreath encircling a portrait of a man with dark hair and beard. Below the portrait is the text "LIEUTENANT GENERAL U.S. GRANT" in red. The bottom of the ribbon displays stylized red and white stripes resembling the United States flag. The right ribbon has a similar structure: the word "RICHMOND" in blue at the top, an eagle, and a green laurel wreath encircling a green oval, without a visible portrait. Below the wreath there is text and decorative elements in red and blue, with an additional shield-like shape incorporating stars and stripes at the base. The overall color palette prominently features red, white, blue, green, and black. Both ribbons have geometric and symbolic motifs, and the drawing is signed by "Dick Atasy" at the bottom right.
title: Silk Badge Panel - Woven
